text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Casino Control (Surveillance) Regulations 2009 and shall come into operation on 23rd September 2009.

chapter.en: PART II SURVEILLANCE CODE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN

text.en:
3.—(1) The Authority shall issue a Surveillance Code setting out the surveillance system requirements for a surveillance system, and may, at any time with reasonable notice to all casino operators, modify the Surveillance Code.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Subject to paragraph (3), a casino operator shall install, operate and maintain a surveillance system for its casino premises and the designated site within which those casino premises are located which satisfies all the surveillance system requirements applicable to it.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) The Authority may, on the application of a casino operator in relation to any surveillance system requirement, modify or waive the surveillance system requirement subject to such conditions as the Authority may impose.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]

chapter.en: PART II SURVEILLANCE CODE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN

heading.en: Surveillance plan for casino premises and designated site

text.en:
4.—(1) A casino operator must not conduct or permit the conduct of any casino operations unless —
(a)there is an approved surveillance plan for those casino premises and the designated site within which those casino premises are located; and
(b)there is a surveillance system which is installed, operated and maintained in accordance with that approved surveillance plan.
(2) An approved surveillance plan for any casino premises and the designated site within which those casino premises are located remains in force until a surveillance plan that is to replace it is approved by the Authority.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART II SURVEILLANCE CODE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN

text.en:
5.—(1) A surveillance plan submitted to the Authority for approval in respect of any casino premises shall and the designated site within which those casino premises are located must comprise the following documents:
(a)detailed blueprints or diagrams of the casino premises and the designated site, indicating —
(i)the areas within the casino premises and the designated site to be monitored by the surveillance system (including the areas designated for entry into, and exit out of, the casino premises);
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(ii)a description of all installations, devices and equipment (whether electronic or otherwise) to be used for the surveillance system;
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(iii)a description of the activities to be monitored by the surveillance system; and
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(iv)drawings which map the placement of installations, devices and equipment (whether electronic or otherwise) comprising the surveillance system, in relation to the activities to be monitored;
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)[Deleted by S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(c)a description of the procedures for the installation, operation and maintenance of the surveillance system;
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(d)a statement by the person in charge of the surveillance system that ––
(i)the surveillance system shown in the surveillance plan satisfies the surveillance system requirements applicable to it; and
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(ii)the surveillance plan complies with the requirements in these Regulations; and
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(e)such other documents as the Authority may, from time to time, require to determine whether the surveillance system satisfies the surveillance system requirements applicable to it.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) The Authority shall not approve any surveillance plan for any casino premises and the designated site within which those casino premises are located unless it is of the opinion that the surveillance plan adequately demonstrates that the surveillance system satisfies or will satisfy all the surveillance system requirements applicable to it.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) The Authority may —
(a)approve a surveillance plan for any casino premises and the designated site within which those casino premises are located subject to such conditions as it may impose; or
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)reject the surveillance plan if any part of it does not satisfy any of the surveillance system requirements applicable to it or does not comply with any of the requirements set out in these Regulations.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]

chapter.en: PART II SURVEILLANCE CODE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN
PART II SURVEILLANCE CODE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN

text.en:
7.—(1) A casino operator which intends to make any change to its surveillance system that will deviate from the approved surveillance plan (other than a change required by the Authority under regulation 10) must apply to the Authority for approval of the proposed change at least 30 days before the date of the proposed change, or within such shorter period as the Authority may allow.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Every application to the Authority under paragraph (1) shall contain ––
(a)details of the proposed change, date and time of the proposed change, reasons for the proposed change, location of the proposed change and the period for which any part of the casino premises and the designated site within which those casino premises are located will be closed to make the proposed change; and
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)[Deleted by S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(c)a statement by the person in charge of the surveillance system that the surveillance system shown in the surveillance plan after the proposed change will satisfy the surveillance system requirements applicable to it.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) The Authority may, in addition, by a written notice, require the casino operator to submit a revised surveillance plan within 14 days of the date of the notice, or such longer period as the Authority may allow, comprising the documents referred to in regulation 5(1)(a) and (c) and any documents required under regulation 5(1)(e), revised to show the proposed change.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(4) An approved surveillance plan shall be revised to the extent that the application under this regulation (including the accompanying documents and any revised surveillance plan) is approved by the Authority.
(5) A casino operator shall ensure that the change to the surveillance system is made in accordance with the proposed change as approved by the Authority under this regulation.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART II SURVEILLANCE CODE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN

text.en:
8.—(1) Where the Authority modifies the Surveillance Code, a casino operator shall, within 30 days of the date it is notified of such change or such longer period as the Authority may allow, submit to the Authority for approval an application for such proposed changes to the surveillance system as may be necessary to satisfy the modified surveillance system requirements applicable to it.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Regulation 7(2), (3), (4) and (5) shall apply to any application for a proposed change to the surveillance system arising from a modification of the Surveillance Code under paragraph (1) as it does to an application for a change proposed by a casino operator under regulation 7(1).
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), where a casino operator considers that the modification to the Surveillance Code requires no change to the surveillance system ––
(a)the casino operator may submit a statement by the person in charge of the surveillance system that the surveillance system shown in the approved surveillance plan, without any adjustment, continues to satisfy the surveillance system requirements applicable to it; and
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(b)the Authority may, on the basis of that statement, allow the casino operator to dispense with the submission of an application under paragraph (1).
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

text.en:
9.—(1) A casino operator shall, immediately upon request by an inspector ––
(a)provide a copy of any recorded image or video recording by the surveillance system;
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)if required to do so, attend before the inspector and answer such questions or provide such information with respect to the recorded image or video recording as the inspector may consider necessary; or
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(c)keep for such period as the inspector may require, a copy of any recorded image or video recording by the surveillance system.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) The Authority may keep the copy of any recorded image or video recording provided to the inspector under paragraph (1).

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

heading.en: Power to require temporary installation or removal of surveillance installation, device or equipment

text.en:
10.—(1) The Authority may, by a written direction, require a casino operator to —
(a)install or remove any surveillance installation, device or equipment or make any other change to any part of the surveillance system for a specified period; and
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)within 7 days from the date the direction is given (or such longer period as the Authority may allow), submit to the Authority a revised surveillance plan (comprising the documents referred to in regulation 5(1)(a) and (e)) showing the installation, removal or other change required to be made,
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
and the casino operator shall comply with such direction.
(2) Regulation 4 shall not apply to a casino operator to the extent that it complies with a direction given by the Authority under paragraph (1)(a) for the specified period.
(3) An approved surveillance plan shall be revised for the specified period to the extent that any revised surveillance plan is submitted under paragraph (1)(b).

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

heading.en: Power to install Authority’s surveillance system

text.en:
11.—(1) The Authority may install, operate and maintain any installation, device or equipment with the capability to observe, monitor and record activities within any casino premises and designated site in the exercise of its functions under the Act, and such installation, device or equipment shall be under the control of the Authority (referred to in these Regulations as the Authority’s surveillance system).
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) The Authority may require the casino operator or any casino employee to provide reasonable assistance to the Authority in the exercise of its powers under paragraph (1), including but not limited to, granting the Authority or its contractors access to such cables and wiring as may be necessary.

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

heading.en: No tampering with surveillance system and Authority’s surveillance system

text.en:
12.—(1) No person shall tamper with or do anything so as to compromise or adversely affect any image or video recorded by, or the proper functioning of, any part of the surveillance system or the Authority’s surveillance system.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Any person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $10,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months or to both.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

heading.en: Duties of licensed special employee in relation to surveillance system and approved surveillance plan

text.en:
13.—(1) A licensed special employee shall not ––
(a)do anything to cause the surveillance system to fail to satisfy the surveillance system requirements applicable to it;
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)make any change to the surveillance system or to the approved surveillance plan without the authorisation of the casino operator; or
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(c)make, authorise or permit any change to the surveillance system or the approved surveillance plan unless the approval of the Authority has first been obtained for the change.
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Any licensed special employee who contravenes paragraph (1)(a), (b) or (c) shall be liable to disciplinary action under section 93 of the Act.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

heading.en: Power of inspector to stop casino gambling, promotional games or casino operations until corrective action taken

text.en:
14. Without prejudice to the generality of section 15(1) of the Act, where an inspector knows or reasonably suspects that —
(a)an offence under regulation 12 has been committed;
(b)there is a malfunction or fault in any part of the surveillance system;
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(c)any part of the surveillance system does not satisfy the surveillance system requirements applicable to it; or
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(d)any part of the surveillance system is not in accordance with the approved surveillance plan,
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
the inspector may —
(i)stop any casino gambling, promotional game or casino operations the effective monitoring or accurate recording of which has been, or may be, compromised or adversely affected until the inspector is satisfied that the necessary corrective action has been taken; and
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(ii)if necessary for the purpose of investigating any suspected contravention of any provision of the Act or these Regulations, seize any part of the surveillance system.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

chapter.en: PART III REGULATORY AND ENFORCEMENT POWERS

heading.en: Power to give directions and take disciplinary action

text.en:
15.—(1) If any casino operator, not acting under a direction referred to in regulation 10 ––
(a)installs, operates or maintains a surveillance system other than in accordance with the approved surveillance plan; or
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(b)makes any change to the surveillance system or to the approved surveillance plan without first obtaining the approval of the Authority for the change in accordance with these Regulations,
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
the Authority may give the casino operator such written directions concerning the surveillance system as it thinks fit, including ––
(i)in a case where the surveillance system nevertheless satisfies the surveillance system requirements applicable to it, a direction to submit a revised surveillance plan for approval or an application for approval of the change, as the case may be, without delay;
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(ii)in a case where the surveillance system fails to satisfy the surveillance system requirements applicable to it, a direction to reinstate the surveillance system in accordance with the approved surveillance plan without delay; or
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(iii)in a case where there has been tampering with, or a malfunction or fault in, any part of the surveillance system, a direction to take such corrective action (including replacement or repair) as may be necessary to rectify the malfunction, fault or alteration within a specified period,
and the casino operator shall comply with such direction.
[S 654/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
(2) Without prejudice to the right of the Authority to give directions under paragraph (1), any casino operator which ––
(a)contravenes regulation 3(2), 4(1), 7(1) or 8(1) (except where the contravention occurs by virtue of the casino operator complying with a direction under regulation 10);
[S 52/2013 wef 31/01/2013]
(b)fails to comply with a request of an inspector under regulation 9(1); or
(c)contravenes paragraph (1) or regulation 10(1) by failing to comply with a direction given by the Authority thereunder,
shall be liable to disciplinary action under section 54 of the Act.
